'''Strike Team Oricon''' was a unit composed of members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that were dispatched to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]] to eliminate the [[Dread Masters]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ogan-Dei]] was one of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaders, and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Tanye Trila]] was one of the highest ranking officers to survive the initial approach to Oricon. Its members typically wore dark gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with white and orange markings, and they had a [[Strike Team Oricon camp|camp]] west of the [[Dread Fortress]].
